## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing reason for it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I used invented, non-identifying data only.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behaviour changed.

## Privacy, safety, and accessibility

- [ ] This change does not add unreviewed tracking, analytics, advertising, accounts, or remote processing.
- [ ] I documented any new data, permission, export, sync, retention, or privacy implication.
- [ ] I did not add medical advice, diagnosis, treatment guidance, or emergency claims.
- [ ] I considered accessibility labels, non-colour cues, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion as applicable.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a recording for UI changes, using fictional and non-sensitive data only.
